description: Atlas alert configurations (Admin API v2 alertConfigs shape) for the Free/Flex primary and ledger clusters. Free and Flex alerts support only Connections, Logical Size, Network and Opscounter conditions. Limits (verified 2026-09-29): Free = 100 ops/s, 500 connections, 512 MB, 10 GB in + 10 GB out per rolling 7 days; Flex = 100 ops/s at the base price (up to 500 at higher cost), 500 connections, 5 GB. There is no total-operations metric: NETWORK_NUM_REQUESTS approximates it, and per-type opcounters localise it. Rendered per cluster by scripts/atlas-alerts.mjs; applied by the owner (atlas alerts settings create --file).

alerts.why: Approaching the 100 ops/s cap (Free: throttled; Flex: next price tier)
One operation type using 40% of the cap
Transactions and findAndModify count as commands
500-connection limit; serverless instances each hold a small pool
Sustained ~7 GB per 7 days of the 10 GB Free allowance
Sustained ~7 GB per 7 days of the 10 GB Free allowance (daily capture reads)
The ledger never deletes receipts; any delete is an anomaly (the ledger-app role has no remove)
